rifle-interlock-special.head: 77bc0c65
rifle-interlock-special.scope: Rifle equipped at login, Rifles reselected after Close Combat, Body Shot next-move announcement and landed animation 11364. Opening stand records and damage/ancillary modifier parity remain separate.

choreography.source: GOB 105 Rifles style requirement and shipped ILDB exchange 11364.
choreography.runtime: CombatAnimations.Special selects the named ILDB move, and the interlock exchange sends it for a landed special.
choreography.test: CombatDepthTests.SpecialsUseTheirOwnShippedMoveAndDuration covers the exact 11364 binding. The stock rifle run announced the next move and played 11364. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/330#issuecomment-7006864509

script.source: GOB 146 selects ThrownDOT. tempmods.py plays the tick FX and deals rounded type-7 damage.
script.runtime: TempMods.DotTick, TimedEffects.Active.TickDamage and PlayerEffects/MobEffects.Ticked run the typed DOT callback.
script.test: CombatStyleTests.ThrownDotsUseTheirStoredValuesAndTheScriptTick checks the GOB-backed templates; AbilityParityTests.DotUsesTheModifierTypeAndStoredCadenceUntilExpiry checks the shared scheduler. Stock Poison Knife applied a 25-second thrown DOT with 3-point ticks. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/312#issuecomment-6995670186

stats.source: GOB 354 and the stat 112/114 ValueType=1 definitions. Current and Max IS -58 with Max IS clamped first, and stat 114 at -50% for 30 seconds.

stats.test: AbilityHostileTests.DestroyResolveTakesCurrentInnerStrengthAtOnce checks vital mutation; DestroyDebuffsScaleNaturalRegenUntilExpiry checks actual ticks and restored rates. ability-status checks max-vital updates and removal.
